thread:
alex: Heads up — scheduling a nightly maintenance window for the ml-burst GPU pool tonight 01:00-01:30 UTC. Purpose: fan calibration + soft cordon + graceful task restore. Staggered drains, KV preheat after each cohort, standby backfill. Will watch latency and tenant oscillation metrics. Details below.

maria: SG. Which cohorts are we hitting first? Any high-priority customers to exclude?

alex: Cohorts: racks r13-r16 first (canary on r13), r17-r20 second. Reserved/dedicated tenants are excluded. Affected only: interruptible and shared-burst workloads. Expect ~25-30m total if no surprises.

devon: Can we do a 2-node canary on r13 and validate perf before continuing? Also suggest we set request rate-limit to 80% for 10m after restore to avoid spike.

alex: Yes — canary will be 2 nodes on r13. I'll patch routing and set rate-limit 80% for 10m. Plan commands: 
```\n./ops/drain.sh --pool ml-burst --cohort r13 --nodes 2 --grace 300\n```
post-drain seed: 
```\n./ops/kv-seed --pool ml-burst --cohort r13 --timeout 600\n```

natalie: Quick cost flag — backfilling from standby adds ~12 GPU-hours tonight, rough incremental ~$2.1k. We can absorb one-off but logging for finance.

andy: Oncall here — I'll monitor dashboards and traces. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ml-pool-maint. Pager criteria: P95 latency > 200ms for >5m OR task evictions > 0.5% sustained for 10m.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: maintenance window tonight 01:00 UTC — will post 10m and 1m warnings.

maria: @alex if canary shows KV hit < 60% do we rollback or extend preheat?

alex: If KV hit <60% we'll extend kv-seed and increase backfill overlap by one rack. Rollback only if we see sustained P99 errors or evictions > 1% across the cohort.

devon: Add a quick traffic fallback to dedicated: `trafficctl shift --from ml-burst --to ml-dedicated --threshold 0.03` (switch if error rate breaches 3%).

andy: I'll also temporarily lower autoscaler threshold to 60% for 20m post-restore to help absorb traffic.

alex: Thanks everyone — summary: window 01:00-01:30 UTC; canary r13 (2 nodes); cohorts r13-20 staggered; KV seed after each cohort; rate-limit = 80% 10m post-restore; rollback on P99/errors/evictions thresholds. Will post postmortem stub after. :thumbsup:

ops-runbook-bot: Log: maintenance created id=mn-9487654321 by alex (cohorts r13-r20, canary r13).
